versions.changelog:
**Major rework: Skill renamed and fully re-architected as a privacy-first, consent-based personal finance ethnographer.**

- Replaces previous always-on observer and cron-script model with a structured, event-based UX ethnography approach (no background scripts, no PII handling).
- Now requires explicit user consent before any logging; displays a detailed privacy/consent notice on first run.
- Logs strictly abstracted, structured behavioral events with finance relevance tagging—never raw PII or sensitive values.
- Introduces separate, scheduled pulses (09:00, 13:00, 17:00 PT) for compiling sanitized reports, which are always reviewed by the participant first.
- All redaction and PII scrubbing is handled exclusively by a Sanitizer subagent, never within the core skill.
- Storage layout, runtime state, event schema, and behavioral abstraction rules completely revised to enforce strict privacy and user control.
